summary: 3D night stealth game in an Ottoman palace, built by Claude Opus 5.5 · Gece Osmanlı sarayında 3D gizlilik oyunu, Claude Opus 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Guards with patrol routes and vision cones drawn on the ground; lantern light and moon shadows decide who sees you
Noise rings, pebbles to lure guards, snuffable lanterns, curtains and chests to hide in
9 night missions in 3 parts (the Courts, the Harem, the Treasury), each with an optional objective; 27 stars
A night score in makam Hicaz (ney over kanun) that speeds up and adds a darbuka when a guard grows suspicious
The ?auto bot plans timed routes with a space-time A* search: 9/9 missions, 27/27 stars, 0 alarms; one index.html, everything generated in code

social.headline: Sneak through Topkapı Palace at night and put the real diamond back before dawn · Gece Topkapı Sarayı'nda gizlice ilerle, gerçek elması şafaktan önce yerine koy

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository; editorial fields hand-written from the README and index.html; no field is generated from a guess
